policies.title: Ukrainian ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Ukraine as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Ukrainian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Ukrainian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Ukrainian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Ukrainian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Ukrainian ordinary passports: Mongolia invitation-conditioned visitor waiver
policies.summary: Mongolia's live consular schedule exempts Ukrainian holders of all passport types for up to 90 days when they present an official invitation.
conditions: Applies only where the ordinary Ukrainian passport holder presents the official invitation required by Mongolia's current consular schedule.
The source applies the 1979 facilitation agreement to Ukrainian nationals and states a maximum stay of 90 days.
Without the required invitation, and for work, residence, special documents or final admission, this policy does not establish a route.

policies.title: Ukrainian ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule includes Ukraine in its no-visa-required visitor cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Ukrainian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The cited Embassy page states a maximum three-month stay for its named no-visa-required cohort.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Mongolia's live MFA consular schedule expressly exempts Ukrainian holders of all passport types for up to 90 days, subject to an official invitation.
